parsed.why: No criminalisation or documented targeting, but also no acceptance, no document-mismatch guidance and no protection naming gender identity; thin data and general stigma leave only open questions, not known exposures.

Sodomy offences carry lashing and death, security forces raid and detain suspected LGBT people, officials bar trans people from public areas, custodial rape and forced tests documented, zero protections, failed recourse.

Simple legal gender recognition, gender-identity anti-discrimination across services, equality ministry, open leadership, no criminalisation or targeting; only gaps are unclassified bias counts and underreporting, with no visitor-facing restriction.
Police assault and sexual harassment of LGBT people with no sanction, 20+ unsanctioned attacks closing an LGBT centre, riot-level hostility, weak hate-crime enforcement despite paper protections.

Universal birth-sex exposures: strip-search by birth sex, prison placement rulings, single-sex space code, ward exclusion linked to a patient's death; hostility rising, but criminalisation absent and legal recourse functions.
